SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsgomListMapper : 고민해결백과(댓글)*/ count(*) FROM AYE100 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/
AND BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%' /*게시글제목명*/
AND WRTR_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%'||#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}||'%' /*작성자명*/
AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%' /*게시글번호*/
AND FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{STARTDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{ENDDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsgomListMapper : 고민해결백과(댓글)조회*/ AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /* 게시글 고유번호 */ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /* 게시글 제목명 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /* 작성자명 */ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS WRTR_ID /* 작성자아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS WRT_DT /* 작성일자 */ --, BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT || '(' || BB.FRST_RGTR_ID || ')' AS CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원 */ , CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD /* 위기유형구분명 */ , CASE WHEN DD.INDEX_SN IS NULL THEN '' ELSE 'Y' END AS SRVY_RESULT_YN /* 설문조사여부 */ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT , (SELECT MAX(BB.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS CNSLTNT_NM_ENCPT /* 상담원명 */ , (SELECT MAX(BB.FRST_RGTR_ID ) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS CNSLTNT_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM AYE110 BB /* 댓글 */ WHERE BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS REPLY_CNT /* 댓글수 */ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제상태대분류구분코드 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 x WHERE x.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD' AND x.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD) AS PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD --문제원인대분류구분코드 FROM AYE100 AA --, AYE120 BB , SAC100 CC , AYE195 DD WHERE 1=1 AND ( AA.DEL_YN != 'Y' OR AA.DEL_YN IS NULL ) AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' /* 게시판유형구분코드 */ AND CC.CMMNS_CD_ID (+) = 'CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 위기유형구분코드 */ AND CC.CMMNS_CD_VALUE(+) = AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD AND DD.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO (+) = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND DD.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD (+) = AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD
AND AA.CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD = #{CRISIS_TYPE_SE_CD} /* 위기유형구분 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} || '%' /* 게시글 고유번호 조회 */
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%' || #{BBSCTT_TTL_NM} || '%' /* 게시글 제목 조회 */
AND C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) LIKE '%' || #{WRTR_NM_ENCPT} || '%' /* 작성자 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제상태대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD = #{PROBM_CAS_LCLAS_SE_CD} /* 문제원인대분류 조회 */
AND AA.PROBM_STTS_LCLAS_SE_CD IS NULL /* 문제상태미등록 */
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{START_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{END_DATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
ORDER BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsgomListMapper : 고민해결백과(댓글)답변조회*/ AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /*게시글내용*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM || '(' || COUNT(BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) || ')' AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*게시글제목*/ , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , AA.BRTH_YMD AS BRTH_YMD /*생년월일*/ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR AS CNTN_IP_ADDR /*아이피*/ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , AA.NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT AS NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT /*비밀번호암호화*/ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS AS RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , AA.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD /*성별*/ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자명*/ , ( SELECT A1.INDEX_SN FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS INDEX_SN /*상담자배정일련번호*/ , ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /*상담사*/ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT /*상담자아이디, 상담자명, 설문*/ FROM AYE100 AS AA , AYE110 AS BB WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/ AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO
AND ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) = #{LOGIN_ID}
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%' /*게시글제목명*/
AND AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%'||#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}||'%' /*작성자명*/
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%' /*게시글번호*/
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{STARTDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{ENDDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
GROUP BY AA.BBSCTT_CN /*게시글내용*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*게시글제목*/ , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , AA.BRTH_YMD /*생년월일*/ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR /*아이피*/ , AA.FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , AA.NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT /*비밀번호암호화*/ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , AA.SXDC_SE_CD /*성별*/ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자명*/ ORDER BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsgomListMapper : 고민해결백과(댓글)미답변조회*/ AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /*게시글내용*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM || '(' || ( SELECT COUNT(AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO) FROM AYE110 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'Y' FROM AYE110 BB WHERE AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ) || ')' AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*게시글제목*/ , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , AA.BRTH_YMD AS BRTH_YMD /*생년월일*/ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR AS CNTN_IP_ADDR /*아이피*/ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , AA.NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT AS NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT /*비밀번호암호화*/ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS AS RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , AA.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD /*성별*/ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자명*/ , ( SELECT A1.INDEX_SN FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS INDEX_SN /*상담자배정일련번호*/ , ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_NM_ENCPT FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) AS CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /*상담사*/ , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_COUNT /*상담자아이디, 상담자명, 설문*/ FROM AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND AA.DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'Y' FROM AYE110 BB WHERE AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = BB.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AND AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = BB.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD AND BB.DEL_YN = 'N' )
AND ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO ) = #{LOGIN_ID}
AND AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_TTL_NM}||'%' /*게시글제목명*/
AND AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT LIKE '%'||#{WRTR_NM_ENCPT}||'%' /*작성자명*/
AND AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO LIKE '%'||#{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}||'%' /*게시글번호*/
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{STARTDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{ENDDATE} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1
GROUP BY AA.BBSCTT_CN /*게시글내용*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*게시글제목*/ , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , AA.BRTH_YMD /*생년월일*/ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR /*아이피*/ , AA.FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , AA.NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT /*비밀번호암호화*/ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , AA.SXDC_SE_CD /*성별*/ , AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자명*/ ORDER BY AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO DESC OFFSET #{START_IDX} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{ROW_COUNT} ROWS ONLY

SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(BB.FLNM_ENCPT) AS NAME /* 상담원명, 상담원아이디 */ , CC.USER_ID AS USER_ID /* 상담원아이디 */ FROM AYC100 AA , SCA100 BB , SAA200 CC WHERE 1=1 AND AA.WORK_YMD = #{WORKYMD} AND AA.USER_ID = CC.USER_ID AND BB.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsgomListMapper : 고민해결백과(댓글)상세조회*/ AA.BBSCTT_CN AS BBSCTT_CN /*내용*/ , AA.BBSCTT_TTL_NM AS BBSCTT_TTL_NM /*제목*/ , AA.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO AS BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ , AA.BRTH_YMD AS BRTH_YMD /*출생년도*/ , AA.CNTN_IP_ADDR AS CNTN_IP_ADDR /*아이피*/ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*작성일자*/ , AA.FRST_RGTR_ID AS FRST_RGTR_ID /*작성자아이디*/ , AA.NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT AS NTABRD_PSWD_ENCPT /*글비번*/ , AA.RDCNT_NOCS AS RDCNT_NOCS /*조회수*/ , AA.ATFINO AS ATFINO /*파일*/ , ( SELECT A1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SXDC_SE_CD' AND A1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = AA.SXDC_SE_CD ) AS SXDC_SE_CD /*성별*/ , C##RG.DEC_B64(AA.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자명*/ , ( SELECT to_char(A1.REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS REG_DT/*상담자배정일자*/ , ( SELECT A1.CONSTT_ID FROM AYA150 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS CONSTT_ID/*상담사명, 메모*/ , ( SELECT A1.MEMO_NM FROM AYA160 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND A1.BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} ) AS MEMO_NM/*상담사명, 메모*/ FROM AYE100 AS AA WHERE 1=1 AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/ AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO}

SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsgomListMapper : 고민해결백과(댓글)댓글상세조회*/ BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글번호*/ ,BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글구분코드*/ ,CMNT_ESNTAL_NO /*댓글고유번호*/ ,CMNT_CN /*댓글내용*/ ,C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT /*작성자*/ ,DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ ,CNTN_IP_ADDR /*접속아이피주소*/ ,FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ ,to_char(FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일자*/ ,LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디*/ ,LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일자*/ FROM AYE110 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ AND DEL_YN = 'N' /*삭제여부*/ AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /*게시글번호*/
mapper.update: UPDATE AYE110 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsgomListMapper : 고민해결백과(댓글)댓글수정*/ CMNT_CN = #{CMNT_CN} ,LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE ,LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO__origin} AND CMNT_ESNTAL_NO = #{CMNT_ESNTAL_NO__origin}
mapper.insert:
SELECT AYA150_SQ01.CURRVAL AS INDEX_SN FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO AYA150 (/*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsmomListMapper : 자녀맘터치법()*/ INDEX_SN /*일련번호*/ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글고유번호*/ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , CONSTT_ID /*상담자아이디*/ , CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /*상다자명*/ , USE_YN /*사용여부*/ , REG_DT /*등록일시*/ , DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일*/ ) VALUES ( AYA150_SQ01.NEXTVAL /*일련번호*/ , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} /*게시글고유번호*/ , '14' /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , #{CONSTT_ID} /*상담자아이디*/ , (SELECT DD.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND #{CONSTT_ID} = CC.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' ) , 'Y' /*사용여부*/ , #{REG_DT} /*등록일시*/ , 'N' /*삭제여부*/ , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} /*최초등록아이디*/ , SYSDATE /*최초등록일*/ , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} /*최종수정아이디*/ , SYSDATE /*최종수정일*/ )
mapper.update: UPDATE AYA150 SET /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbsmomListMapper : 자녀맘터치법()*/ CONSTT_ID = #{CONSTT_ID} , CONSTT_NM_ENCPT = (SELECT DD.FLNM_ENCPT FROM SAA200 AS CC , SCA100 AS DD WHERE 1=1 AND #{CONSTT_ID} = CC.USER_ID AND CC.ENFSN_NO = DD.ENFSN_NO AND DD.DEL_YN = 'N' ) , REG_DT = #{REG_DT} , LAST_MDFR_ID = #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14' AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN__origin}
mapper.select: SELECT INDEX_SN /*일련번호*/ , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO /*게시글고유번호*/ , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD /*게시글유형구분코드*/ , CONSTT_ID /*상담자아이디*/ , CONSTT_NM_ENCPT /*상다자명*/ , USE_YN /*사용여부*/ , REG_DT /*등록일시*/ , DEL_YN /*삭제여부*/ , FRST_RGTR_ID /*최초등록아이디*/ , FRST_REG_DT /*최초등록일*/ , LAST_MDFR_ID /*최종수정아이디*/ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /*최종수정일*/ FROM AYA150 WHERE 1=1 AND INDEX_SN = #{INDEX_SN}
SELECT RFRNC_NO , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , CONSTT_ID , MEMO_NM FROM AYA160 WHERE 1=1 AND BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO = #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} AND BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD = '14'
mapper.insert: INSERT /* isry.couns.constt.medscsnntabrd.mapper.BbscttListMapper.insertMemo : 자녀맘터치법 메모등록 */ INTO AYA160 ( RFRNC_NO , BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO , BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , CONSTT_ID , MEMO_NM , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT ) VALUES ( ( SELECT NVL(MAX(RFRNC_NO),0)+1 FROM AYA160 ) , #{BBSCTT_ESNTAL_NO} , '14' , #{CONSTT_ID} , #{MEMO_NM} , #{FRST_RGTR_ID} , SYSDATE , #{LAST_MDFR_ID} , SYSDATE )
